name: Android App Development with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose
certifications: Android Basics with Compose course badges
Google Play Academy store listing certificate

beginner.summary: For developers and freshers building their first Android apps. Covers Android Studio and the emulator, Kotlin for Android, null safety, classes and collections, Jetpack Compose layouts and state, Material 3, lazy lists, navigation, ViewModels and lifecycle, coroutines and Flow, Retrofit, Room, DataStore, image loading, permissions and device features, Hilt, testing, notifications and WorkManager, and publishing to Google Play.
prerequisites: Knows programming basics in any language
Comfortable with variables, functions and loops
A laptop with 16 GB RAM for Android Studio and the emulator
outcomes: Build Android apps in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose
Structure apps with ViewModels, coroutines, Room and Retrofit
Use device features, notifications and background work safely
Test, sign and publish an app on Google Play

days.topic: Android Development Overview and Android Studio Setup
subtopics: The Android platform and app ecosystem
Kotlin as the language for Android
Installing Android Studio and the SDK
Running on a physical device with USB debugging
days.lab_task: Install Android Studio, create a Compose project, run it on an emulator and a phone, change the UI and app name, and find a planted crash in Logcat.
days.deliverable: First running app in a Git repository
checks: App installs and runs on a physical device
Crash cause found from the Logcat stack trace
objectives: Explain how Android apps are built
Run and debug a first app

days.topic: Kotlin Essentials for Android Developers
subtopics: Kotlin style used in Android code
days.lab_task: Write Kotlin functions for an expense app: totals by category, date formatting, input checks with when and extension functions for currency display, with unit tests.

days.topic: Kotlin Null Safety, Classes and Collections in App Code
subtopics: The Elvis operator and smart casts
Collection operations: filter, map and groupBy
days.lab_task: Model expenses, categories and budgets with data classes and sealed classes, handle missing values with null safety and group expenses by month with collection operations.
checks: No unsafe !! calls in the model
Sealed classes cover every state of a budget
Monthly totals correct for sample data

days.topic: Jetpack Compose: Composables and Layouts
subtopics: Text, Image, Button and other basic components
Modifiers for size, padding and click handling
Thinking in Compose compared with XML views
days.lab_task: Build the expense list item, summary card and add-expense screen layouts with composables and modifiers, and preview them in light and dark themes.
checks: Previews show light and dark versions
List item reused with different data

days.topic: State in Compose
days.lab_task: Add input state to the add-expense form with hoisted state, keep values across rotation with rememberSaveable and show live totals with derived state.
checks: Total updates as amounts are typed

days.topic: Material 3 Theming and Components
subtopics: Scaffold, top app bar and floating action button
Accessibility of colours and touch targets
days.lab_task: Create a brand theme with Material Theme Builder, support dynamic color and dark mode, and build the main screen with Scaffold, a top bar, a FAB, cards and a snackbar.
checks: App follows the system dark theme
Colours follow the wallpaper on Android 12 and later
Snackbar confirms a deleted expense with undo

days.topic: Lists with LazyColumn and LazyGrid
days.lab_task: Show expenses in a LazyColumn grouped by month with sticky headers, stable keys and swipe to delete, and show categories in a lazy grid.
checks: Item removed with undo in a snackbar
Items keep state when the list changes

days.topic: Navigation in Compose
days.lab_task: Add navigation between list, detail, add and settings screens with type-safe arguments, bottom navigation and a deep link that opens an expense.
checks: Detail screen opens the selected expense
Back button returns to the right screen
Link opens the expense detail screen

days.topic: ViewModels and the Activity Lifecycle
days.lab_task: Move screen logic into ViewModels with UI state classes and StateFlow, collect state lifecycle-safely, survive process death with SavedStateHandle and test it with adb.
checks: Screen state kept by the ViewModel
Draft expense restored after process death

days.topic: Coroutines and Flows for App Work
subtopics: Why the main thread must stay free
days.lab_task: Load data with suspend functions on the right dispatcher, expose a Flow of expenses, cancel work when screens close and handle errors without crashing.
checks: Work stops when the screen closes
Error state shown instead of a crash
objectives: Use Flow for streams of data

days.topic: Calling REST APIs with Retrofit and Kotlin Serialization
subtopics: GET, POST, PUT and DELETE calls
Testing with a mock web server
days.lab_task: Sync expenses with a REST API using Retrofit and Kotlin serialization, log requests with an interceptor, handle errors and timeouts and test with MockWebServer.
checks: App shows expenses returned by the API
Friendly message for server and network errors

days.topic: Local Data with Room
days.lab_task: Store expenses and categories in Room, observe queries as Flows, add a relationship and a migration, and inspect the database while the app runs.
checks: List updates automatically when data changes

days.topic: Preferences with DataStore
days.lab_task: Build a settings screen for currency, theme and reminders backed by DataStore, react to changes across the app and migrate an old SharedPreferences value.
checks: All screens show the new currency
Settings kept after the app restarts

days.topic: Images with Coil
days.lab_task: Add receipt photos to expenses with the photo picker, load them with Coil using placeholders and caching, and check memory use with large images.
checks: Receipt chosen from the gallery and shown
Memory stays stable while scrolling receipts

days.topic: Permissions, Camera and Location
subtopics: Asking at the right time and explaining why
Location with the fused location provider
days.lab_task: Capture receipts with CameraX and tag expenses with location, request permissions in context, handle denial gracefully and offer approximate location.
checks: App explains and keeps working without the feature
CameraX photo saved to the expense
App works with approximate location only

days.topic: Dependency Injection with Hilt
days.lab_task: Wire repositories, Retrofit and Room into ViewModels with Hilt modules and scopes, and replace the repository with a fake in tests.
checks: Tests use a fake repository through Hilt
Planted binding error fixed with the cause explained

days.topic: Testing ViewModels and Compose UI
days.lab_task: Write unit tests for ViewModels and repositories with fakes and Turbine, write Compose UI tests for adding and deleting expenses and run them on an emulator.
checks: Add and delete flows pass in Compose UI tests
Coverage report generated for app logic

days.topic: Notifications and WorkManager
subtopics: The notification permission on Android 13 and later
Opening the app from a notification
days.lab_task: Schedule a daily budget reminder with WorkManager, show a notification that opens the budget screen, request the notification permission and run a chained sync job.
checks: Sync runs only on an unmetered network

days.topic: Building, Signing and Publishing to Google Play
subtopics: App signing and Play App Signing
Store listing, content rating and data safety
days.lab_task: Create a signed release bundle with R8 shrinking, set up a Play Console listing with data safety answers and release the app to an internal testing track.
days.deliverable: Release bundle and internal test release
checks: Data safety form matches what the app collects
Testers install the app from Play

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Expense Tracker App
days.lab_task: Complete the expense tracker with Compose screens, navigation, ViewModels, Room storage, API sync, receipts, reminders, tests and an internal Play release, then demo it.
days.deliverable: Repository, Play internal release and demo recording
checks: Add, edit, sync and remind flows work end to end
App installs from the internal track
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one app

intermediate.summary: For Android developers who have shipped an app. Covers layered architecture, offline-first apps with Room and sync, advanced Compose, Paging 3, advanced coroutines and Flow, modularisation and version catalogs, Credential Manager and passkeys, push with Firebase Cloud Messaging, WorkManager and foreground services, Media3, maps, accessibility, adaptive layouts, Compose animation, app security, instrumented and screenshot tests, CI/CD with Fastlane, baseline profiles and Firebase analytics, Crashlytics and Remote Config.
prerequisites: Has built and released an Android app with Kotlin and Compose
Comfortable with ViewModels, coroutines, Room and Retrofit
outcomes: Add authentication, push, media, maps and background features
Make apps accessible, adaptive, secure and fast
Test and deliver apps through CI/CD with monitoring

days.topic: App Architecture: UI, Domain and Data Layers
subtopics: Data layer repositories and data sources
days.lab_task: Restructure an app into UI, domain and data layers with use cases and repositories, apply unidirectional data flow and add architecture tests that enforce the layers.
checks: Test fails when UI code calls a data source directly
Business rules live in use cases with tests
UI sends events and receives state only

days.topic: Offline-First Apps with Room and Sync
subtopics: Local data as the source of truth
Sync strategies: pull, push and two-way
days.lab_task: Make a field service app fully usable offline with Room as the source of truth, queue offline edits, sync with WorkManager, resolve conflicts and show sync status.
checks: All features work in airplane mode
Offline edits reach the server when online
Conflicting edit resolved by the agreed rule

days.topic: Advanced Compose: Side Effects, Performance and Custom Layouts
subtopics: Side effects: LaunchedEffect, DisposableEffect and rememberUpdatedState
days.lab_task: Fix a screen that recomposes too often using stability fixes and deferred reads, write a custom layout and a Modifier.Node, and confirm gains with recomposition counts.
checks: Recomposition counts drop on the busy screen
Custom layout arranges items as designed

days.topic: Paging 3 for Large Lists
subtopics: Loading and error states for pages
days.lab_task: Page a 100,000-item catalogue from the network into Room with RemoteMediator, show load and error states, support refresh and retry and test the paging source.
checks: Pages load smoothly from cache and network

days.topic: Advanced Coroutines and Flow Operators
subtopics: Combining flows: combine, zip and flatMapLatest
days.lab_task: Build search with debounce and flatMapLatest, combine filters and data into one UI state with stateIn, wrap a callback API with callbackFlow and test it with virtual time.
days.deliverable: Search and filter feature with tests
checks: Old searches cancelled when the query changes
Debounce test runs instantly with virtual time

days.topic: Modularisation and Gradle Version Catalogs
days.lab_task: Split the app into feature and core modules with convention plugins and a version catalog, enable the configuration cache and measure build times.
checks: Modules use convention plugins with no copied build logic

days.topic: Authentication: Credential Manager, Passkeys and OAuth
days.lab_task: Add sign-in with passkeys and Google through Credential Manager, an OAuth flow for a company identity provider, secure token storage, refresh and a biometric unlock.
checks: Passkey sign-in works without a password
Expired access token refreshed without user action
objectives: Add modern sign-in to Android apps

days.topic: Push Notifications with Firebase Cloud Messaging
subtopics: Handling messages in foreground and background
days.lab_task: Add FCM push with token registration, data messages that update the app, grouped notifications with deep links and topic subscriptions, and debug a delivery problem.
checks: Notification arrives in foreground and background

days.topic: Background Work with WorkManager and Foreground Services
days.lab_task: Upload large photo batches with WorkManager and progress, run a location-tracking foreground service with the correct type and check battery impact.
checks: Upload finishes after the app is closed

days.topic: Media: Playback with Media3 and ExoPlayer
days.lab_task: Build a training video player with Media3, streaming playback, a media session with notification controls, background audio and picture-in-picture.

days.topic: Maps and Location Services
days.lab_task: Show job sites on a map with clustering, track the user's location efficiently, trigger a geofence on arrival and test with mock locations.
checks: Nearby markers clustered at low zoom
Arrival detected at a job site

days.topic: Accessibility in Android Apps
days.lab_task: Audit the app with TalkBack and Accessibility Scanner, fix labels, touch targets, font scaling and contrast problems and add accessibility checks to UI tests.
checks: Screens work at the largest font size

days.topic: Adaptive Layouts for Tablets, Foldables and Large Screens
days.lab_task: Make the app adaptive with window size classes, a list-detail layout on tablets, a navigation suite that switches between bar and rail and support for foldable postures.
days.deliverable: Adaptive app with screenshots per size
checks: Tablet shows list and detail side by side
Main flows usable with keyboard and mouse

days.topic: Animations in Compose
days.lab_task: Add animated visibility for filters, animated content for totals, a shared element transition from list to detail and gesture-driven card swipes that respect reduced motion.
checks: Image moves smoothly from list to detail
Animations shorten when animations are reduced

days.topic: App Security: Keystore, Encryption and Network Security
days.lab_task: Encrypt sensitive data with keys from the Keystore, block cleartext traffic, review pinning, harden a WebView and scan the APK with MobSF.
checks: Sensitive data unreadable on a rooted test device
HTTP requests refused by the network config

days.topic: Instrumented Testing, Screenshot Tests and Test Doubles
subtopics: Screenshot testing with Roborazzi or Paparazzi
days.lab_task: Write instrumented tests with Hilt fakes for main flows, add screenshot tests for key screens and run everything on Gradle managed devices.
checks: Main flows pass on managed devices
Screenshot test fails on a layout change

days.topic: CI/CD for Android with GitHub Actions and Fastlane
subtopics: Running lint, unit tests and instrumented tests
days.lab_task: Build a pipeline that lints and tests on each pull request, signs release bundles with secrets and uploads to the internal track with Fastlane and release notes.
checks: Lint and tests run on every pull request
Release bundle signed without keys in the repository
New build appears on the internal track

days.topic: Performance: Baseline Profiles, Startup and Jank
days.lab_task: Measure startup and scrolling with Macrobenchmark, add a baseline profile, fix a memory leak found by LeakCanary and a janky list, and record the gains.
checks: Startup faster with a baseline profile
LeakCanary reports no leaks after the fix
Frame timing improves on the list

days.topic: Analytics, Crash Reporting and Remote Config with Firebase
days.lab_task: Add analytics events for key flows, Crashlytics with non-fatal errors, a feature flag in Remote Config and an A/B test, with consent handled correctly.
checks: Crash appears in Crashlytics with the stack trace
Remote Config flag turns a feature on without a release
Analytics off until the user consents

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Offline-First Delivery Tracking App
days.lab_task: Build a delivery tracking app with layered architecture, offline-first sync, passkey sign-in, push, maps and geofences, adaptive layouts, accessibility, tests, CI/CD and Crashlytics, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repository, Play test release, reports and presentation
checks: Deliveries completed offline and synced later
Tests, accessibility and performance reports meet targets
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one app

advanced.summary: For senior Android engineers and mobile leads. Covers large-scale architecture, Gradle build performance, Kotlin Multiplatform, Compose internals, memory, rendering and battery performance, security hardening and Play Integrity, feature delivery, design systems, testing strategy, release engineering, on-device AI, Wear OS, TV and Auto, privacy and compliance, real-time features, mobile observability, migration from Views and Java, target SDK upgrades, mobile back-end design and production troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Several years building production Android apps
Strong Kotlin, Compose and architecture skills
Has released apps to large audiences
outcomes: Architect and scale large Android codebases and teams
Engineer performance, security and reliability for large audiences
Share code across platforms and adopt on-device AI
Lead releases, migrations and production troubleshooting

days.topic: Large-Scale Android Architecture
days.lab_task: Design the module and ownership structure of a super app for six teams, enforce dependency rules, plan cross-feature navigation and record the key decisions.
checks: Build fails on a forbidden module dependency
Every module has an owning team

days.topic: Build Performance and Gradle at Scale
days.lab_task: Profile a slow build with build scans, move from kapt to KSP, fix configuration-time work, enable remote caching and cut CI build time.
checks: CI build faster with remote caching

days.topic: Kotlin Multiplatform for Shared Business Logic
subtopics: When to share code across platforms
Shared storage with SQLDelight or Room
days.lab_task: Move the business logic, networking and storage of a feature into a KMP module used by the Android app and a small iOS app, and measure what was shared.
days.deliverable: Shared module used on two platforms
checks: Same module powers Android and iOS features
iOS code calls shared code naturally
Share of feature code shared reported

days.topic: Compose Internals: Composition, Recomposition and Snapshots
days.lab_task: Trace recomposition through the snapshot system, explain why a scope recomposes, fix stability problems and show work moving between composition, layout and draw phases.
checks: Unstable parameters made stable with measured gains
Animated value read in draw phase only
objectives: Use the right phase for work

days.topic: Advanced Performance: Memory, Rendering and Battery
days.lab_task: Profile the app on a low-end device with Perfetto, fix memory churn, rendering stalls and wake lock misuse, and add performance budgets to CI.
checks: Frame timing stable on the low-end device
CI fails when a benchmark regresses

days.topic: Security Hardening and Play Integrity
days.lab_task: Threat model the app, verify device and app integrity on the server with Play Integrity, move secrets off the device and run a penetration test with Frida.
checks: Server rejects requests from a tampered app
No API secrets in the APK

days.topic: Modular Feature Delivery and Dynamic Features
subtopics: When dynamic delivery is worth it
days.lab_task: Move a large rarely used feature into an on-demand module, install it at runtime with progress, test it with bundletool and measure the size saved.
days.deliverable: Dynamic feature module and size report
checks: Feature downloads and opens at runtime

days.topic: Design Systems for Android Teams
days.lab_task: Build a Compose design system module with tokens, five components, two brand themes, a catalog app and screenshot tests, and migrate one feature to it.
days.deliverable: Design system module and catalog app
checks: Screenshot tests cover every component state
Feature uses only design system components

days.topic: Advanced Testing Strategy for Large Apps
subtopics: Contract tests with the back end
days.lab_task: Assess a large app's tests, rebalance by risk, add back-end contract tests, shard tests across a device farm and cut CI time.
checks: Back-end change breaks a contract test

days.topic: Release Engineering: Staged Rollouts, Feature Flags and Rollbacks
tools: Remote Config or a flag service
days.lab_task: Run a release train with a staged rollout, halt it on a crash spike, disable the faulty feature with a kill switch and add an in-app update prompt.
checks: Rollout halted when crash rate rises
Faulty feature disabled without a release
In-app update shown for old versions

days.topic: On-Device AI with Gemini Nano, ML Kit and LiteRT
subtopics: ML Kit vision and language APIs
Generative AI on device with Gemini Nano where supported
days.lab_task: Add on-device receipt text recognition with ML Kit, an on-device summary with Gemini Nano where supported and a cloud fallback, and compare latency and quality.
checks: Cloud model used on unsupported devices
Latency and quality compared for both paths

days.topic: Wear OS, Android TV and Android Auto
subtopics: Wear OS apps and tiles with Compose for Wear OS
Android TV with Compose for TV
Android Auto and car app templates
Data sync between phone and watch
days.lab_task: Add a Wear OS tile and app for delivery status, a TV dashboard screen and an Android Auto list template, sharing data and logic with the phone app.
days.deliverable: Companion experiences on three form factors
checks: Wear OS tile shows live status
TV screen usable with a remote
Car template shows the delivery list

days.topic: Privacy and Compliance on Android
days.lab_task: Audit what data the app and its SDKs collect, remove unneeded collection, add consent and account deletion and update the data safety declaration to match.
checks: Data collected by each SDK listed
Data safety form matches actual collection

days.topic: Real-Time Features: WebSockets and Live Updates
days.lab_task: Add live driver tracking with WebSockets, reconnect with backoff, fall back to push when the app is in the background and measure battery cost.
checks: Driver position updates in real time
Connection restored after a network drop
Battery cost of live tracking measured

days.topic: Observability for Mobile Apps
subtopics: What to measure in mobile apps
days.lab_task: Instrument key journeys with traces, monitor network calls and ANRs, compare two releases and set alerts for crash and ANR spikes.
checks: Checkout journey timing visible per release
Alert fires on an ANR spike

days.topic: Migrating Legacy Views and Java Code to Compose and Kotlin
tools: Android Studio Java to Kotlin converter
days.lab_task: Migrate two legacy XML screens to Compose with interop, convert a Java module to Kotlin, replace RxJava in one feature with Flow and track progress.
checks: Old and new screens work together
Kotlin module passes the original tests
Feature uses Flow with the same behaviour

days.topic: Android Platform Changes and Target SDK Upgrades
subtopics: Yearly Android releases and Play target SDK requirements
Library upgrades that come with SDK changes
days.lab_task: Raise the app's target SDK by one version, fix behaviour changes such as edge-to-edge and predictive back, test on the new version and plan the work for the next release.
checks: App builds and passes tests on the new target
Screens draw correctly behind system bars

days.topic: Mobile Back-End Design: BFFs and APIs for Apps
subtopics: What apps need from back ends
Versioning APIs for old app versions
Security between app and back end
days.lab_task: Design a BFF for the app with mobile-shaped payloads, version support for old releases, a sync endpoint and a server-driven home screen, and test it with the app.
checks: Home screen loads with one request
Old app version keeps working after a BFF change
Home screen layout changed without a release

days.topic: Troubleshooting Production Android Issues: ANRs, Crashes and Vitals
days.lab_task: Work through four production issues: an ANR on startup, a crash on one device family, an out-of-memory crash and a regression after release, fix each and write one post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Incident notes and a post-incident review
checks: ANR rate drops after the fix
Review lists causes and follow-up actions

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Multi-Module Super App
days.lab_task: Design and build a multi-module super app with team-owned features, a design system, shared KMP logic, dynamic delivery, on-device AI, security hardening, staged releases and observability, then defend it to a review panel.
days.deliverable: Repository, release evidence and architecture defence
checks: Features built and released by separate modules
Performance, security and test reports meet targets
Review panel questions answered with evidence
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one app
